component.name: Yar
component.summary: Your friend for apps on Linux

description.p: Yar (the Persian word for "friend") shows everything installed on your computer in one place, whether it came from your distribution, from Flathub, from the Snap Store or from a file you downloaded yourself, and helps you look after it in plain language.

ul.li: See every app, where it came from, where it lives and what it may reach
Install, update and remove Flatpak apps and your distribution's packages
Add an app you downloaded as a file or a link, checked before anything happens, and remove it cleanly later
Compare a download with the hash its publisher states
See a preview before every change, and undo it from the history
See where your disk space goes and which sources your apps come from

description.p: Yar never runs as root, never runs a downloaded file to inspect it, and moves what it removes to the Trash.

screenshot.caption: Every app on your computer, wherever it came from
An app in the Store, with every source that offers it
A preview before anything is installed

description.p: The first public version: install, update and remove apps, add apps you downloaded, and a history with undo.
